thesis.title: HISTORICAL PRELIMINARY — COIN Q3 2024 top-line YoY screen pass (SEC-only, no price/valuation)
thesis.thesis: HISTORICAL PRELIMINARY CANDIDATE (not a current view, not a recommendation). On the frozen offline SEC-source adapter, Coinbase Global, Inc. (COIN) passed the single screening rule — issuer-reported top-line revenue YoY growth >= 20% — for the period Q3 2024 ended 2024-09-30, released 2024-10-30. Reported total_revenue was USD 1,205,193 thousand in Q3 2024 versus USD 674,148 thousand in Q3 2023, a derived YoY rate of 78.8% (derived from the two reported figures; the adapter's own derivation, not a separately disclosed rate). The pass is a one-rule, single-issuer, historical disclosure observation only. It says nothing about share price, valuation, analyst targets, future returns, or current market data — all of which are excluded dimensions of this screen. Passing this rule does not establish that COIN was or is an attractive investment.
assumptions: The 78.8% YoY figure is a derived rate computed from two issuer-reported total_revenue values (USD thousands) in the Q3 2024 shareholder letter; it is not a separately disclosed YoY percentage.

The reported top-line label is 'total_revenue' for COIN; the adapter warns that issuer top-line labels differ (total revenue vs total net revenues), so this rate is comparable only to COIN's own prior-year disclosure and must not be ranked against other issuers.
The screen's threshold is met on the issuer's own reported basis for Q3 2024; no alternate metric was substituted.
The evidence packet is a frozen offline adapter snapshot, not live market data; packet omissions are not SEC filing omissions.
catalysts: A future SEC filing (e.g., a subsequent 10-Q or shareholder letter) that discloses whether the Q3 2024 revenue mix shift away from transaction revenue persisted or reversed.
Disclosure of a revenue breakdown by transaction vs subscription-and-services for the following quarter, which would test whether the YoY growth was broad-based or concentrated.
invalidations: A corrected or restated Q3 2024 or Q3 2023 total_revenue figure that reduces the derived YoY rate below 20%.
Evidence that the 78.8% derived rate was computed on a mismatched basis (e.g., total revenue vs total net revenues) rather than COIN's own consistent prior-year top line.

evidence.locator: Q3 2024 shareholder letter page 3 operating summary; Q3 2024 condensed consolidated statements of operations
evidence.note: Derived YoY rate from the two reported values; not a separately disclosed percentage.

evidence.locator: Q3 2024 shareholder letter page 3 operating summary
evidence.metric: total_revenue QoQ percent (reported) and transaction_revenue QoQ percent (reported)
evidence.note: Counterpoint field: sequential contraction, with transaction revenue falling faster than total revenue.

evidence.locator: Q3 2024 condensed consolidated statements of operations
evidence.metric: net_income (rounded) and pretax crypto investment portfolio loss (rounded)
evidence.note: Secondary context: rounded figures; the pretax crypto portfolio loss exceeds reported net income in magnitude, indicating earnings were sensitive to non-operating crypto marks.

The frozen adapter explicitly excludes these dimensions. No price, market cap, multiple, or valuation conclusion is available or asserted. This is a packet-scope limitation, not a claim that the SEC filing omits such information.

# COIN — Historical SEC-Disclosure Candidate Research (Frozen Offline Adapter)

## 1. Screen outcome: RETAINED

`finance-tools__screen_stocks` was called with `require_complete=false`, market US, symbol COIN. Result: **1 passed, 0 failed, 0 rejected.**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Issuer | Coinbase Global, Inc. (COIN) |
| Period | Q3 2024, ended 2024-09-30 |
| Release date | 2024-10-30 |
| Rule applied | issuer-reported top-line revenue YoY ≥ 20.0% |
| Reported top-line label | `total_revenue` |
| Q3 2024 total revenue | USD 1,205,193 thousand |
| Q3 2023 total revenue | USD 674,148 thousand |
| Derived YoY | 78.8% (derived from the two reported values; not a separately disclosed rate) |
| Source URL | https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1679788/000167978824000186/q324shareholderletter.htm |
| Full SHA-256 | `f9a2d60153fd79c6ac9f7dfcd80344995ffa4b121c336808b2e2f13968230a52` |
| Locators | Q3 2024 shareholder letter p.3 operating summary; Q3 2024 condensed consolidated statements of operations |
| Fact IDs | COIN-Q3-TOTALREV-2024, COIN-Q3-TOTALREV-2023, COIN-Q3-REV-QOQ, COIN-Q3-TRANREV-QOQ, COIN-Q3-NETINCOME, COIN-Q3-CRYPTOLOSS |

No criteria failed. The adapter's own basis warning notes issuer top-line labels differ (total revenue vs total net revenues), so this rate is meaningful only against COIN's own prior-year disclosure.

## 2. Independent counterpoint (different supplied field)

The most material counterpoint is **not** the YoY pass but the **sequential direction**: reported total revenue fell **−17% QoQ**, and **transaction revenue fell −27% QoQ** — i.e., transaction revenue contracted materially faster than the top line. A 78.8% YoY rate and a −17% sequential rate are both true of the same quarter; the YoY figure is measured against a weak prior-year base, while the QoQ figures describe the current trajectory. The divergence between the two QoQ rates also suggests the revenue mix was shifting away from transaction revenue within the quarter, which the single YoY rule cannot see.

Secondary context from a third field: rounded **net income of USD 75 million** alongside a rounded **pretax crypto investment portfolio loss of USD 121 million** — the loss exceeds reported net income in magnitude, indicating earnings were sensitive to non-operating crypto marks. (Both are rounded USD millions as reported.)

## 3. Discriminating follow-up question

Did the Q3 2024 sequential decline in transaction revenue (−27% QoQ) continue or reverse in the following reported quarter, and was the YoY growth broad-based across revenue lines or concentrated in a mix shift away from transaction revenue? Answering this requires the next SEC filing's revenue breakdown — it cannot be resolved from the Q3 2024 packet.

## 4. Missing price / valuation boundary

**No price, market capitalization, multiple, analyst target, or valuation conclusion is available or asserted.** `share_price`, `valuation`, `analyst_target`, `future_return`, and `current_market_data` are explicit excluded dimensions of this adapter, which is a frozen offline SEC-source snapshot, not live market data. This is a limitation of the supplied packet's scope — it is **not** a claim that the SEC filing omits such information. Passing this one rule does not mean COIN was or is an attractive investment.

## 5. Thesis saved

Exactly one historical preliminary candidate thesis was created: `th_ed556ac6df064215b061`, status `researching`, conviction 2, with the full source URL and SHA-256, key numbers, the counterpoint, the follow-up question, and the valuation boundary in structured evidence. `next_review_at` was omitted (no genuinely future-dated review was specified).

## 6. Scope compliance

No trades placed; no live market tools used; no cross-issuer ranking on a common date (single issuer only, and the adapter forbids ranking by these rates); no alternate metric substituted for the threshold; no claim that packet omissions are SEC filing omissions.
